description: Ask the Historian page (historian.html), backlog wp-hist-01b: the question field is 16 px with a visible label; a polite live region receives the answer count or the no-result sentence; a failed load of any of the 15 data files shows an inline message with a Retry button that reads them all again; the first-person lines carry the catalogue wording (rows 9 and 10 of chapter 11, Appendix A). Head tags are not touched. Superseded when the candidate page of WP-HIST-11 ships.

patches.find: #ask-row { position: sticky; bottom: 0; display: flex; gap: 10px;
patches.repl: #ask-row { position: sticky; bottom: 0; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px 10px;
patches.note: the sticky bar (line 82) wraps so the label takes its own line above the field and the Ask button; the row gap is 6 px, the column gap stays 10 px
the field (line 83) is 16 px (no zoom on focus in iOS Safari); min-width 0 lets it share the second line with the button on a 320 px screen
new rules after the #loading rule (line 86): the visible label, the visually hidden live region, the failure box and the Retry button (44 px target, 2 px focus outline)

patches.repl: Loading the battle's records…
patches.note: line 106: the container of the failure message (an alert, empty until a load fails) and the polite live region (visually hidden, present from the first paint so that a screen reader watches it)

patches.find: <input id="ask" type="text" aria-label="Ask the Historian a question" placeholder=
patches.repl:
<label class="hx-label" for="ask">Ask the Historian a question</label>
    <input id="ask" type="text" placeholder=
patches.note: line 110: the visible label carries the words of the old aria-label, which goes (the label names the field; the visible and the spoken name are the same)

lines 131-136: the one Promise.all of the 15 fetches becomes getJSON + loadRecords inside a retry loop; every later line of the script is unchanged and still sees oobResults, vigResults, chronResults and terrain
line 244: say(), brief() and the count words, placed before ask()

patches.find: addMsg('bot', "I couldn't find anything specific about that in the regimental records, stories, chronology, or terrain data. Try a regiment name (e.g. \"1st Minnesota\"), a place (\"Devil's Den\"), or a moment (\"Pickett's Charge\").");
patches.repl:
addMsg('bot', 'Nothing in the records matches “' + esc(query) + '”. Try a regiment (1st Minnesota), a place (Devil’s Den), or a moment (Pickett’s Charge).');
      say('Nothing in the records matches “' + brief(query) + '”.');
patches.note: line 253: the first-person no-result line becomes the catalogue sentence (row 10); the question is escaped; the live region gets the sentence without the advice
lines 257-262: after the answers are in the transcript the live region says how many there are

patches.find:
addMsg('bot', "I'm ready. Ask me about a regiment, a commander, a place on the battlefield, or a specific moment.");
})();
patches.note: lines 274-275: the first-person greeting becomes the catalogue sentence (row 10); after a successful Retry the question field takes focus, because the pressed button is gone
